quarterly_data.quarter: Broadcom press release: Broadcom to Advance NTT DOCOMO's Private Cloud with VMware (10-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Broadcom signed a 10-year agreement with NTT DOCOMO covering licenses, technical assistance and maintenance support for VMware products including VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF), the core of DOCOMO's private cloud since 2019; Broadcom says it is Broadcom Japan's first 10-year comprehensive VMware agreement. The platform is to evolve into one that runs virtual machines, containers and AI workloads on a common foundation.
